docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,500.00 FILED BY CABLE, THURAYA A. AS TO DEFENDANT AMERICAN COLLEGE OF TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-25-2007 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
